{{Quote|Would you consider this to be the high point of your administration?''"<br />"''Later today, the office of the Supreme Chancellor will issue a statement.|The Human journalist and Sei Taria|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' worked as a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> After a session of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] that saw the ratification of a [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|resolution]] subjecting [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|free trade routes]] to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] taxation, the Human was one of [[Unidentified female Human correspondent|many]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek correspondent|journalists]] who surrounded [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] to field questions. Their concerns were addressed by Valorum's [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]], [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]].
